Motion.description: Code-owned motion tokens (durations, easing curves, movement). Figma variables cannot hold easing curves, so code is the source; the Figma file mirrors the durations in a FLOAT collection named Motion. A Figma variables sync must leave this file alone. Reviewed in docs/context/motion-transitions-review-2026-10-01.md.
rules: Exit is one step shorter than enter: slow → base, base → fast, fast → xfast.
Animate transform, opacity and colours; expand and collapse with grid-template-rows. Never width, height, top, left or margin.
Productive by default: emphasized only for surfaces entering the screen, exit for surfaces leaving it.

tokens.name: Motion/Duration/Xfast
tokens.use: Press and release, a check or dot appearing, tooltip and small overlay exit.

tokens.name: Motion/Duration/Fast
tokens.use: Hover, colour and opacity state changes, tooltip enter.

tokens.name: Motion/Duration/Base
tokens.use: Small movement (indicators, toggle thumb, chevrons), popover and menu enter, large overlay exit.

tokens.name: Motion/Duration/Slow
tokens.use: Large surfaces entering: dialog, sheets, side panel, drawer, toast, accordion expand.

tokens.name: Motion/Movement
tokens.use: Multiplies every animated distance, scale step and rotation. 0 under prefers-reduced-motion: surfaces crossfade instead of moving, colour and opacity still change (WCAG 2.3.3 covers motion, not fades).
